_note: Pre-existing failures on the COMMITTED tree, measured in a clean clone of main (844dc84) on 2026-07-25 with the current tier definitions. Their existence is why the quick tier is gated through scripts/test-baseline.mjs rather than raw pass/fail: a gate against zero would be permanently red, and an always-red check teaches everyone to ignore it. The gate fails only on failures NOT listed here, so regressions still turn CI red. Shrinking this list is the goal; when it reaches 0, drop the baseline indirection and gate on `npm run test:quick`.
_flakyNote: Several entries are LOAD-DEPENDENT flakes, not deterministic failures: they pass 3/3 in isolation on both the working tree and a clean clone of main, but fail intermittently under a full parallel run. Confirmed examples: tests/agent/overview-maintainer.test.ts, tests/core/toggle-complete.test.ts, tests/core/observability/incidents.test.ts. Baselining them keeps the regression gate usable — an intermittent red would otherwise train everyone to rerun until green, which defeats the gate. De-flaking them is separate follow-up work; each is a real (if low-severity) test-isolation bug.
_collectionFailures: Entries ending in '<file failed to load or collect>' mean the FILE died at import time, not that an assertion failed. vitest reports those with an empty assertionResults array, so the gate synthesizes this key — otherwise a broken import (the most likely regression of a refactor) would produce zero new keys and silently pass. There are currently none, which is the correct state.
